[quote="MigrantP"]

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked: We're not planning to have an alpha test for Spirit Island as the game doesn't lend itself well to a text-based interface. However there's a beta testing perk available on the campaign, so you can get in on that!
posts.raw: We're not planning to have an alpha test for Spirit Island as the game doesn't lend itself well to a text-based interface. However there's a beta testing perk available on the campaign, so you can get in on that!

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
Will existing Handelabra playtesters also be playtesting, or do they need to back at the Beta Tester level to get in on the action? :-) 

(And I like the "Why Indiegogo?" section? ;-)
posts.raw:
Will existing Handelabra playtesters also be playtesting, or do they need to back at the Beta Tester level to get in on the action? :-) 

(And I like the "Why Indiegogo?" section? ;-)

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked: Existing Handelabra beta testers will be invited to be a beta tester for the game when the time comes. No need to take the beta testing perk if you're backing us on the campaign, but we'd be happy to have your support as a backer at any level regardless!
posts.raw: Existing Handelabra beta testers will be invited to be a beta tester for the game when the time comes. No need to take the beta testing perk if you're backing us on the campaign, but we'd be happy to have your support as a backer at any level regardless!

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked: Oh, I definitely backed! I was a little slow this time, though: I only made it in as #5. ;-)
